english.notes:
(i) Section 4(2) of the Clean Neighbourhoods and Environment Act 2005 provides that for the purposes of this section "restricted works" means:-
(a) works for the repair, maintenance, servicing, improvement or dismantling of a motor vehicle or of any part of or accessory to a motor vehicle;
(b) works for the installation, replacement or renewal of any such part or accessory.
(ii) Section 4(3) of the Clean Neighbourhoods and Environment Act 2005 provides that a person is not to be convicted of an offence under this section in relation to any works if he proves to the satisfaction of the court that the works were not carried out:-
(a) in the course of, or for the purposes of, a business of carrying out restricted works; or
(b) for gain or reward.
However subsection 4(3) does not apply where the carrying out of the works gives reasonable cause for annoyance to persons in the vicinity.
(iii) Section 6(9) of the Clean Neighbourhoods and Environment Act 2005 provides that the £100 fixed penalty ticket fee set by section 6(8) of the Act may by order of an authorised person of a local authority be substituted by a different amount.
(iv) Section 4(5) of the Clean Neighbourhoods and Environment Act 2005 provides additional defences to the offences
